profile.headline: Web Developer at Atomic Revenue
profile.summary:
Internet/Digital Media professional with strong background in software development, interface design, project management, and web-based marketing. Passionate about integration and utilization of Web 2.0 technologies including social networking, blogging, podcasting and eCommerce.

Specialties: Multimedia software development, acquisition and editing of video and audio, photography, and data management.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.locationName: St. Louis City County, Missouri, United States
positions.description: Proud member of Atomic Revenue's Digital Operations team, working with clients, account managers, writers, designers, strategists, and analysts to grow small to mid-size businesses through Revenue Operations.

positions.title: Owner and Chief Consultant
positions.locationName: St. Louis City County, Missouri, United States
positions.description:
Davis Interactive started out as a one-man custom software development shop, specializing in Adobe Director. Using this power and versatile tool, I developed desktop applications before the internet became popular. In the years since, I added interactive touchscreen kiosks to our product list, and then a wide variety of internet-based marketing, learning, and productivity tools.

As the the client and project list grew, I hired developers and designers to handle the growing demand for my services. Several times during the life-span of Davis Interactive, I worked full time for IT and software companies, coming back and restarting my company as industry and career requirements changed.

Clients and employers have included Apple Computer, Bristol Meyers, U.S. Department of Agriculture, Missouri Botanical Garden, General Motors, Master Key Consulting, Color Associates, and many others including consumer product companies, institutions of higher education, and non-profits organizations.

positions.title: Internet Marketing and Social Media Consulting
positions.description: I recently changed the focus of my company from Web and Media Development to Internet Marketing and Social Media Consulting. I am no longer providing services under the Davis Interactive brand that I established in 1993, opting to be more direct and leverage my name in the market place. My focus is to help companies clearly define their audience, creating a Buyer Persona for each category of customer. Then we proceed to identify how to best get the marketing message in front of those customers. Finally, we work to repurpose existing content and create new content that will resonate with the buyer and deliver it to where they are most likely to respond to it.

positions.description: Manage all aspects of Internet marketing including web design, development and maintenance; photography, podcast and video production; system support, other media and marketing services.
